_comment: Box Split's read-aloud prompt (the same for every lesson) and the How to play captions, which Koda says step by step.
Reactions come from the common pack. Must match locales/en.json word for word.
prompts: Split the grid into boxes. Each box has one number, and that many squares.
phrases: Every number needs a box. The number says how many squares.
A 1 is a box on its own. Tap it twice.
This 3 needs 3 squares. Drag from corner to corner.
This 2 takes the square below it.
The last 1 is a box on its own.
Every square is in a box. Done!
